claim: By default, sharing within the organization restricts access to consumers in the same organization, so an account that leaves the organization loses access to the resources in the resource share; for account-to-account sharing within the organization, you can keep access by setting RetainSharingOnAccountLeaveOrganization to True when you create a new resource share.

qualifiers.condition: for account-to-account shares only: RetainSharingOnAccountLeaveOrganization set to True when the share is created
